title: adesmia racemosa
intro: Adesmia racemosa, commonly known as "Cocha" in Peru, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, native to the Andean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate various health conditions such as digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Adesmia racemosa include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Adesmia racemosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
